description: Source code for the ResourceProfileManager class in Apache Spark, managing resource profiles including addition, validation, and retrieval, with support for different cluster managers and dynamic allocation.

classes.name: ResourceProfileManager
classes.description: Manages resource profiles within Spark, supporting addition, validation, and retrieval, with cluster manager and dynamic allocation considerations.

methods.name: defaultResourceProfile
methods.description: Returns the default resource profile used by the manager.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given resource profile is supported in the current cluster configuration.

methods.name: canBeScheduled
methods.description: Determines if a task with a specific resource profile ID can be scheduled on an executor with a given resource profile ID.

methods.name: addResourceProfile
methods.description: Adds a new resource profile to the manager after validation.

methods.name: resourceProfileFromId
methods.description: Retrieves the resource profile associated with a given ID.

methods.name: getEquivalentProfile
methods.description: Finds an existing resource profile equivalent to the provided one.
